name: Exp_ColorXCCXCandle
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXCCXCandle custom indicator, which uses dual-smoothed candle coloring to identify trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns bullish (color=2) and sell positions when it turns bearish (color=0), with configurable entry/exit switches for each direction. Position sizing is managed through multiple money management modes including lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXCCXCandle自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用双重平滑的K线着色来识别趋势方向。当指标转为看涨（颜色=2）时开多仓，转为看跌（颜色=0）时开空仓，每个方向均可配置入场/出场开关。仓位管理支持多种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorXCCXCandle指标的趋势方向判断，该指标通过两重平滑算法（分别用于价格和趋势动量）对K线进行着色分类，颜色值为2代表看涨趋势，0代表看跌趋势，1代表中性。入场条件为：当信号K线的颜色值从非2变为2时开多仓，从非0变为0时开空仓，且需要前一K线的颜色状态发生变化才触发信号，体现了趋势转折的确认逻辑。出场条件包括：当趋势反转时根据配置自动平仓（多仓在看跌信号时平仓，空仓在看涨信号时平仓），同时设置了固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比、基于扣除亏损后的余额百分比和基于扣除亏损后的可用保证金百分比，通过MM参数控制风险比例。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms库中的标准化函数，每笔交易都有明确的止损和止盈设置，风险收益比为1:2，且支持滑点容忍度设置。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ColorXCCXCandle indicator's trend direction identification, which classifies candles through dual smoothing algorithms (one for price and one for trend momentum), where color value 2 represents bullish trend, 0 represents bearish trend, and 1 represents neutral. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the signal bar's color value changes from non-2 to 2, and a sell position opens when it changes from non-0 to 0, requiring the previous bar's color state to have shifted, which provides trend reversal confirmation logic. Exit conditions include: automatic position closing on trend reversal based on configuration (long closes on bearish signal, short closes on bullish signal), with fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) set for each trade. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, balance after loss percentage, and free margin after loss percentage, controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio. Money management uses standardized functions from the TradeAlgorithms library, each trade has explicit stop loss and take profit with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio, and slippage tolerance is configurable via the Deviation parameter.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：固定手数/余额百分比/可用保证金百分比等
parameters.description_en: Money management mode (free margin/balance/reduced margin/reduced balance/fixed lots)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引

pros: 具有明确的止损止盈设置，风险收益比为1:2，符合合理的交易风险控制原则
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同风险偏好的交易者
使用双重平滑算法进行趋势判断，信号经过充分平滑处理，减少了假信号的可能性
买卖方向的入场和出场均可独立开关控制，便于灵活调整策略
使用新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复交易，减少了过度交易的风险
pros_en: Has explicit stop loss and take profit with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio, following sound risk management principles
Supports multiple money management modes with high flexibility for different risk preferences
Uses dual smoothing algorithms for trend determination, reducing false signals through thorough smoothing
Buy/sell entry and exit can be independently toggled, allowing flexible strategy adjustment
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点的固定值可能不适合所有市场条件，缺乏动态调整机制
没有检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓加大风险敞口
依赖自定义指标ColorXCCXCandle，如果指标文件缺失则EA无法运行，且指标逻辑不透明
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在点差较大或流动性差的时段可能产生不利成交
信号仅基于指标颜色变化，没有结合价格行为、支撑阻力或其他确认条件
cons_en: Fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points may not suit all market conditions, lacking dynamic adjustment
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially leading to duplicate entries and increased exposure
Depends on custom indicator ColorXCCXCandle; if the indicator file is missing the EA fails, and indicator logic is opaque
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, may execute at unfavorable prices during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
Signals are based solely on indicator color changes without price action, support/resistance, or other confirmation conditions
improvements: 增加动态止损止盈机制，根据ATR或市场波动性自动调整止损止盈距离
添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓，并在开仓前检查点差是否合理
improvements_en: Add dynamic stop loss/take profit mechanism that automatically adjusts distances based on ATR or market volatility
Add position check logic to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction, and verify spread is reasonable before opening

risk_points: 没有检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定的止损止盈点数在不同市场波动条件下可能不合适
缺少点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大可能导致不利成交
risk_points_en: No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially leading to duplicate entries increasing exposure
Fixed stop loss/take profit points may be inappropriate under different market volatility conditions
No spread filter; widening spreads during high volatility periods may result in unfavorable fills
